Environment · India

India faces water scarcity amid monsoon deficit, impacting agriculture and daily life

Several Indian states are grappling with a significant monsoon deficit, leading to critically low reservoir levels and raising alarms for the agricultural sector, particularly the Kharif crop season. Authorities are implementing measures such as restricting water usage and urging farmers to delay sowing. In one instance, a protest for drinking water was met with police action and social media curbs.
